result.title: How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies
result.comment: This paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method's efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to $1.7\times$ compute efficiency over the dominant ``scale-the-trajectories'' practice.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 agentic RL 的训练数据分解为任务、环境、轨迹三个基数轴并加一个奖励密度控制变量，在不同模型、领域和 PPO/GRPO 下拟合各自的缩放关系，用拟合结果给合成方法「定价」，再把预算分配写成约束优化，推出 Chinchilla 式 compute-optimal 配方。
AI.relevance_reason: LVR 的轨迹训练与监督同样面对「在有限预算下扩哪一轴」的问题，该文按轴给出的缩放指数与合成—真实比例临界值可供核查，用来推断轨迹级监督相对任务多样性的实际收益；但研究对象为纯文本 agentic RL，未涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，迁移需自行验证。
